description: A pale horn with one clean curve, snapped at the base. Gravecharger wears a pair and notices neither.
lore: Split it, boil it soft, press it flat and it goes translucent: four panes to a horn, thin enough to see a flame through and tough enough to laugh at wind. That is the horner's whole trade, and the reason a fire on an open fell stays lit in weather. A pane costs less than a candle and outlives forty of them.

The joke among horners is that the finest stock in the country grows on [[monsters/undead_charger|Gravecharger]], and getting any is a matter of standing in the right place at a very wrong moment. In fact they walk its lines, which run straight and are close to the last straight thing out that way, and pick up what it sheds and does not miss. Every lantern on the old eastern circuit was glazed like this, back when there was a circuit. The horners are still cutting panes, and could not tell you now who buys them.
gm_notes: A craft that outlived its customers. Horn panes are a good prop for any fire scene; the last line is the Thinning shown from the supply side.
